articles.title: India is set to overtake Japan — and, yes, California — and become the world’s fourth-largest economy
articles.mainIdea: India is set to overtake Japan — and, yes, California — and become the world’s fourth-largest economy
articles.summary: MarketWatch: India is set to overtake Japan — and, yes, California — and become the world’s fourth-largest economy. No major economy can compete with the booming 7.3% GDP growth the Reserve Bank of India forecasts in 2025-26. Related tickers mentioned: INDA.
